name: a-model-payload-names-a-real-swift-type
breaks: a `model` payload can name a Swift type that does not exist, so every key it declares is proved against nothing. That was the live state: blog_finding pointed at `BlogFinding` from the day it was written and the real type is `QualityFinding`. Nothing caught it because only the `reader` branch resolved anything, which is a check that reads as covering a thing it never touches (#1132, L96)
